spans.s: श्चुत्, and 1. श्च्युत् श्च्युत् (derived from a noun based on श्च्यु, cf. च्यु), i. 1, Par. To ooze, to drop,

(श्चुत्).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. श्च्युतित.
 1. Shed, sprinkled.
 2. Dropping, flowing.
 --With the prep. उप उप, To drop,

= Rigv. i. 87, 2 (श्चुत्).
 --With नि नि, श्चुत्, To drop down,

; Bhaṭṭ. 14, 79 (श्चुत्).
 --Cf. Goth. skevjan (= श्चु); skura; A.S. scur.
